thread:
Rae: MarineBridge POC kickoff — migrating off CompetitorX. They want minimal SDK changes, response alignment for our reranker, and token billing parity. Blockers?
Jon: Main risks: tokenizers differ (causes reranker score shifts), CompetitorX uses custom stop-token behavior, and they have strict egress IPs.
Priya: For reranker parity we can run a 2-stage flow: call CompetitorX + our reranker, then learn a small score mapping on their calibration set. Usually gets top-k parity high.
Hank: Security asks: FIPS KMS, signed audit exports, encrypted logs-in-transit. We support FIPS on Private with customer-managed keys. Need allowlist for staging egress.
security-bot: Compliance checklist created: marinebridge-poc-checklist.
deploy-bot: Presales env spin-up requested: marinebridge-rerank-shim -> staging (job 9910).
Rae: Pricing question — they'd like delta if we run a quantized reranker vs CompetitorX. Jon, ballpark $/1k tokens and latency impact?
Jon: Ballpark: quantized reranker ~0.5-0.7x CompetitorX per-token depending on batching. Latency p95 +15-25% at low concurrency; batching can bring it close.
Priya: Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) Top-1 rerank parity >=93% on their seed queries; 2) reconciled token billing within 10% after our script; 3) staging reachable from their allowlist + FIPS-enabled KMS. Target 2-week POC.
Rae: Action items: ask them for calibration set, sample billing CSV, and list of top endpoints. I'll send the ask.
Jon: Quick smoke test for shim:
```\ncurl -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/v1/marinebridge-rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"candidates":["A","B","C"],"context":"<ctx>"}'\n```
Priya: I'll upload SOC2 excerpt + KMS integration notes to the presales folder.
Rae: Tagging Legal for no-training + retention addendum.
Hank: Once they provide allowlist, I'll open the staging IPs.
Rae: Marking thread presales-marinebridge for follow-up.
